Author: essen__
Content: Does someone know if we can have **core_VDD > IO_VDD** when using the ocd IO?

Author: essen__
Content: Aside from the totally fair objection of *"wtf are you doing?"* is there anything that would technically prevent me from doing this, such as a diode between core\_vdd and io\_vdd?

Author: 246tnt
Content: No you can't

Author: 246tnt
Content:
(1) There is a parasitic body diode.
(2) level converters are not the same to up convert or down convert ... so that wouldn't work anyway.
